reel.caption:
Cancelling a ₹2,000 train ticket this Diwali: did you know you can lose ₹1,000 of it?

Under the railways' revised refund rules (from April 2026), a confirmed ticket cancelled more than 72 hours before departure loses only a flat fee.
Between 72 and 24 hours, 25% of the fare is cut. Between 24 and 8 hours, 50%: ₹1,000 on a ₹2,000 ticket.
Less than 8 hours before departure, there is no refund at all.

Have you ever lost money on a late cancellation?

Sources: two news reports on the railways' revised cancellation rules (March 2026); the ₹ figures are our own illustrative arithmetic.

For education only. Not investment advice.
